title: Empty Snapshot on Blank Tapes
statement: Let $d$ be a configuration with four work tapes and let $q$ be a state. Suppose that every tape other than tape $0$ is blank at every integer cell. Then the snapshot formed from $d$ using state $q$, displacement zero, and two empty buffer words is exactly the configuration with state $q$, the same input-head position, all the same work-tape contents and head positions, and the same output as $d$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $d$ with four work tapes
Every work tape indexed by $j\ne 0$ is blank at every integer cell
